product.olivetti-m30030.summary: 25 MHz i486SX desktop with VLSI VL82C486 chipset and integrated WD90C31 video.
product.olivetti-m30030.history: The M300-30 is the 25 MHz i486SX version of this 1992–1993 M300 platform. It shares its board, firmware and peripherals with the M300-30P, which has a DX2/50; BluMach offers them as two machines so that each has its own processor.
product.olivetti-m30030.technical.verifi: BIOS 1.09/Diagnostics 1.04 has completed POST, CPU, cache, memory, keyboard, RTC and protected-mode tests, booted MS-DOS 5.00 and retained the calendar. At 4 MB, memory is accounted as 640 KB base + 3072 KB extended + 384 KB dedicated = 4096 KB.
product.olivetti-m30030.technical.limita: Partial bootable emulation. The VL82C486 is an initial model; the WD90C31 uses the compatible WD90C30 core and the PC87311/87312 is approximated with PC873xx. The board configuration register, from which the BIOS reads the bus speed and the Super I/O address, has been reconstructed from the disassembly. The other documented RAM configurations and more software remain to be validated.
product.olivetti-m30030.technical.manual: Olivetti service guide chapter 36; primary source for M300-30 and M300-30P.
